name: Karasuma Mii
source: [url=/c5401]Hiroshi's[/url] classmate. She is also the best friend of [url=/c11617]Maika[/url] and her bandmate as well. Mii is popular among her class' boys because of her of her mother-like aura and her appearance; in reality, she is spoiled. Hates bitter foods, and is one of the normal students not to be afraid of [url=/c5398]Ai[/url]; in fact, Mii wants to become her friend.
